integrity: The mathematical proof and the two embedded, standalone Python checks establish the explicitly stated finite classification. Programs were run and their packaged versions are replayed after delivery.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the fixed four-dimensional cube only. The existence of total perfect codes and the covering of the complete bipartite graph are prior results. The full text of Kwon--Lee (2014) was inaccessible, leaving a residual historical-equivalence risk. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Antipodal rigidity and two-replacement mobility of total perfect codes on \(Q_4\)
